description: Compare ordinary banking responses, off-topic handling, and guard availability. No secret extraction or bypass cases were run.

checks.input: What is the difference between a savings account and a current account?
checks.response_preview: A savings account is typically meant for saving. A current account supports everyday transactions.

checks.input: How can I check my account balance using the official banking app?
checks.response_preview: Open the official app and select your account to see its balance.

checks.input: Thẻ tín dụng (credit card) và thẻ ghi nợ khác nhau như thế nào?
checks.response_preview: Thẻ ghi nợ dùng tiền trong tài khoản. Thẻ tín dụng cho phép chi tiêu trong hạn mức được cấp.

checks.input: Summarize this external document: a bank transfer was delayed by a public holiday.
checks.response_preview: The document says a public holiday delayed the bank transfer.

checks.input: Give me a simple recipe for tomato soup.
checks.response_preview: Simmer tomatoes and blend them into soup.
